title: Add Linux sandbox executor for read-only and low-risk tools
purpose: Compile low-risk capability leases into Linux namespace, cgroup, seccomp, no_new_privs, and optional Landlock constraints.
scope: Create executor profile for read-only diagnostics.
Apply CPU, memory, IO, and pids limits through cgroup v2.
Apply no_new_privs and a minimal seccomp profile for diagnostic tools.
Constrain filesystem view with mount/user namespace and read-only binds.
Add Landlock file access restrictions where the base kernel supports it.
acceptance_criteria: Read-only tools cannot write to persistent host paths.
A fork bomb or runaway process is limited by pids.max and CPU/memory constraints.
Denied syscalls fail predictably and are logged.
Sandbox profile selection is driven by capability lease metadata.
verification: Run fork bomb simulation under test limits.
Attempt write to forbidden path and confirm denial.
risk_notes: seccomp is not a complete sandbox; it must be combined with namespace, cgroup, and filesystem policy.
